g.text: Gossip: each node tells a few random peers, so news spreads in O(log N) rounds
Example with 8 nodes. Orange = knows the news (a new container started on node 1).
Round 3: the last node hears it. Each round roughly multiplies the informed nodes, so N nodes need about log N rounds (exact timing depends on cluster size and gossip
The news here is: "container MAC/IP X lives on host Y", which each node needs to forward overlay traffic. Packets may be lost: another peer repeats the news, which is why
